capabilities: insert many attachments in one command from the palette, ribbon, or right-click menu
embed each file at the cursor with configurable prefix, delimiter, and suffix text
save files to the vault's native attachment folder like the built-in command
open a bundled demo vault documenting every feature
extras: Documentation ships as a demo vault included with each release and readable on GitHub; beta versions install via BRAT; debug messages are hidden by default. The README lists similar plugins and was last checked for alternatives on 2026-10-26.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's built-in Insert attachment command opens a file picker that accepts exactly one file.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Insert attachment command accepts exactly one file per dialog, so attaching several files means repeating the command once per file.

relations.evidence: Same batch-insert goal; configurable link prefix, delimiter and suffix
Different insertion point: current cursor; any file type
Narrower focus: batch attachment insertion; configurable text around links
Broader input: any file type; follows link-format settings; configurable surrounding text

summary: Multi-file attachment picker that saves and embeds any number of selected files at the cursor in a single command.
